items.title: Al Chez interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, February 13, 2019
items.q: Oh there I am playing with you know Ben E. King and John Fogarty and Sting

ctx.x: Yeah. You should have kept a diary.

Well it was kind of like if your job is to meet people and you meet people every day, after about 17 years you forget some of the people you met. Well our gig was playing with different bands and different people every day. You know what I mean? So after a while you kind of, you don’t forget — I forgot. So you do forget. The Rock & Roll Hall of Fames, I did 19 or 20 Hall of Fame inductions. Man we played with everybody. We played with everybody. And the cool thing is they used to put, when people would buy…
trumpet mic and I’d be like oh no, oh no, stay away. That’s mine. That’s mine. So when they got close I would just like pound a note to keep them away.
